text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, to make it as an Umadol, it's
extra
important to keep up with the
latest trends! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know much about Umadols,
but I
think that's a great point!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then first things first—folding fans! The
flashier
and fluffier they are, the more
attention you'll
grab. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy folding fans? I don't think I've
ever seen
those...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flashy and super fluffy? Oooh! Sounds

great—perfect for an Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Pair that with a glittering bodycon dress
and
you'll be super fly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bodycon? I've never heard that either...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With that settled, let's go get changed!
We've got
to jet while the iron's hot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do iiit! ☆ Woo! Umadols,
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait a minute! I'm pretty sure none of those are the latest trends!
